ext_desc.message: Allow copying. Remove copy protection. Free, easy. Enable text copying, context menu, right mouse button. Turn on selection.

enableProtectedTextToCopyDscr.message: This is the main feature that adds the ability to select/copy/paste text on websites with copy protection.

showSupportHelpIconDscr.message: This feature is deprecated in the Origin version to ensure privacy and reduce bloat.

showDetectTextOverlayLbl.description: Show detection text from image overlay

showDetectTextOverlayDscr.message: This feature is deprecated in the Origin version as it requires external server processing.

showContextMenuDscr.message: Adds a 'Copy' item to the right-click menu when text is selected.
